name: omp-wezterm-worker
description: Spawn an independent OMP worker session inside a WezTerm pane or tab. The user watches it live while the main agent keeps working; the worker's final result is delivered back into the main session.

scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/transcript.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/registry.test.ts tests/monitor.test.ts tests/job.test.ts tests/lifecycle.test.ts tests/architecture.test.ts tests/ste100.test.ts tests/stop.test.ts tests/limits.test.ts tests/usage.test.ts tests/trial-report.test.ts tests/trial-paths.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/worker.integration.test.ts tests/worktree.integration.test.ts tests/result.integration.test.ts tests/live-worker.integration.test.ts tests/nested.integration.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run ste100 && npm run test
